Target pattern (left panel): TL, TR, BC.
Currently lit (N): TC, TR. TL and MC are W (not N).
So what's needed is: TL→N, BC→N, and TC→? and MC→?. If the goal is exactly {TL, TR, BC} in N, then TC and MC need to be turned off (N→?). In level 1, once the 4 targets were lit, the tail shrank and the tiles stayed green. There, I never once clicked a non-target tile.
Maybe the win condition is: all target tiles are N (extras don't matter?). Or exactly the target set only.
Let me try clicking TL (50,25) and BC (60,30) to make them N. Then check if the tail shrinks (if extras don't matter). If the tail doesn't shrink, try toggling TC/MC off (click again? N→g?).

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def panel(tag):
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = {}
    for (r0,c0,name) in [(49,24,'TL'),(49,29,'TC'),(49,34,'TR'),(54,24,'ML'),(54,29,'MC'),(54,34,'MR'),(59,24,'BL'),(59,29,'BC'),(59,34,'BR')]:
        cells[name] = L[r0+1][c0+1]
    print(tag, cells)
    # tail size check
    ys=[]; xs=[]
    for r in range(30,40):
        for c in range(26,38):
            if L[r][c] in 'bS': ys.append(r); xs.append(c)
    if ys: print("  tail rows",min(ys),max(ys),"cols",min(xs),max(xs))
panel("before")
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':25},{'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30}])
panel("after TL+BC")
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','board_changed')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
